question: What condition affects even the wise at the nectar-point despite its essence?
premises: The essence of juice is present
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise may experience burning at the tip of nectar by its essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is context-dependent.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
